paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh Haman kumpinu Esther toh an nekna ah ahong uhi.
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

paite: Uain adawn lai un ani nih ni in kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna, kumpinu Esther? Ahon phalsak ding uh bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat leng piak in na om ding," achi hi.
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

paite: Huchi in Esther kumpinu'n adawng a, "Aw kumpipa, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan a, kumpipa kipahna ahihleh, ka thumna ah ka hinna leh ka mite hinna piak in om hen:
english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

paite: Zuak in ka omta ua, kei leh ka mite, hihgawp a om ding in, thah a om ding in leh hihmang ding in. Sikhapa ding leh sikhanu ding a zuak a om hi le ung zaw, melma in kumpipa siatna gun bawl theita kei mahleh, dai dide ding hi veng in " achi hi.
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

paite: Kumpipa Ahasueras in thu agen a, kumpinu Esther kiang ah, "Kua ahia, koi a om ahia, huchibang a lungtang sung a tum ngam?" achi hi.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

paite: Esther in, "Melma leh gal, hiai giloupa Haman mah," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa leh kumpinu ma ah Haman alauta hi.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

paite: Huchi in uain dawnkhamna a kipan aheh ziak in kumpipa adingkhia a, inpi huansung ah alut a; huchi in kumpinu Esther kiang a ahinna ngen ding in Haman adingh hi; kumpipa'n asiatna ding in hoih lou a tup a-om chih lah athei ngal a.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

paite: Kumpipa Kulhpi huan a kipan uain an nekna mun ah ahong kik a; huchi in Esther omna tutphah nem tung ah Haman apuk hi. Kumpipa'n, "Inn sung a ka ma a kumpinu nangawn sual ding ahi hia?" achi hi. Kumpipa kam a thupawt bang in, Haman maitang atuamsakta uhi.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

paite: Huai lai in kumpipa ma a om zel michilgehte lak a khat, Harbonah in, "En un, Haman in Mordekai, kumpipa gum a thugenpa a dia abawl, khailupna khuam tong sawmnga a sang, Haman inn ah adingh hi," achi hi. Huan kumpipa'n, "Huai ah amah khailum un," achi hi.
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

paite: Huchi in Mordekai a dia abawlkholhsak khailupna khuam ah Haman akhailumta uhi. Huchi in kumpipa thangpaihna adaita hi.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.
